_comment: DIAB GS30 grid-scored core WITH the kerf-damage halo correction (see notes/refs/laustsen2014_grid_scored_rve.md). Same nominal geometry as diab_gs30.json, but the grid-scoring tears open foam cells along each cut: 'cell_size' (mean foam cell diameter, mm) sets how far the damage reaches and 'scoring.damage_cells' how many cell-diameters beyond each kerf wall. Opened cells fill with resin (porosity-scaled), graded by distance from the cut wall -> a resin-rich halo that raises the effective resin Vf and stiffness above the sharp-kerf nominal (toward the physically-effective values the paper's CT scan, Fig 13, implies). Requires the numpy backend (auto-routed).
